description: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets available for different languages from 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the year, labeled “Year,” with categories ranging from 2012 to 2022 in sequential order. The vertical axis, labeled “Number of datasets,” represents a logarithmic scale ranging from 10⁰ to 10², with tick labels at intervals of 10⁰, 10¹, and 10². Each year contains a grouped set of bars, representing the number of datasets for different languages: “All other” (orange), “Arabic” (green), “Bengali” (red), “Spanish” (purple), and “Russian” (brown), as well as a blue bar representing datasets for languages not specified in the legend. In 2012, the blue bar is approximately 1, while the other language bars are below 1. In 2019, the blue bar reaches a height of approximately 10¹, while the “All other” bar reaches a height of approximately 8 x 10¹. The bars are arranged in groups by year, with each language represented by a distinct color within each group. The bars are not sorted within each year, and no bars are visually emphasized.
